title: Add desktop user improvements for multi-CLI orchestration

phases.label: web search and intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Current CLI setup and human-in-the-loop references were checked before implementation.
phases.notes: Checked current references for Tauri commands/permissions, CLI setup sources, and human-in-the-loop decision inbox patterns.

phases.label: local context and plan
phases.bottleneck_notes: Existing desktop specs, monitor UI structure, and prior CLI session implementation shaped the slice boundary.
phases.notes: Reviewed platform desktop specs, user-flow requirements, previous CLI session implementation, and monitor component structure.

phases.label: Tauri commands and monitor UI
phases.bottleneck_notes: Largest phase because Tauri command contracts, React state, CSS, readiness checks, and user flow had to stay aligned.
phases.notes: Added human decision inbox list/answer commands, setup guides, session mode presets, and decision answer UI.

phases.label: requirements, specs, and history records
phases.bottleneck_notes: Bilingual requirements/spec/history artifacts add overhead but preserve future implementation context.
phases.notes: Updated requirements, specs, architecture docs, README, web records, research notes, user request summaries, and request traces.

phases.label: verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Verification included UI checks, static build, platform readiness, and governance close-out validators.
phases.notes: Ran workspace-monitor and platform-desktop-app checks/tests/build plus governance close-out validators.

bottleneck_candidates: User-facing Desktop UI changes require keeping Tauri command contracts, monitor UI state, CSS, readiness checks, and bilingual specs aligned.
Rust/Cargo absence prevents direct Tauri compilation, so readiness checks and source inspection carry more verification weight until the toolchain is installed.
summary.next_measurement_improvement: Start _tools/work-timer at task intake so future multi-slice desktop work uses automatic timestamps.
